title: Maninka language - Wikipedia
text: Maninka (also known as Malinke), or more precisely Eastern Maninka, is the name of several closely related languages and dialects of the southeastern Manding subgroup of the Mande language family (itself, possibly linked to the Niger–Congo phylum).

title: Kita Maninka language - Wikipedia
text: Kita Maninkakan, or Central Malinke, is a Manding language spoken by about a million people in Mali, where it is a national language. About 10% are ethnically Fula. The Kagoro variety is 86% lexically similar according to Ethnologue, and is being replaced by Bambara.
